//: Editors open this repo at the root, but the Python lives in backend/ and
its interpreter in backend/.venv. Without this, Pylance falls back to a
system Python and reports third-party imports (anthropic, langchain_openai,
fastembed) as unresolvable even though the tests pass — the code is fine,
the editor is just looking in the wrong place.
gitignored, so a settings file there fixes one machine and nobody else's.
extraPaths mirrors how the suite runs: `cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. pytest`,
which is what makes `from app.config import settings` resolve.
